title: Customer acknowledgment notes
summary: This topic mostly consists of brief service-writeup acknowledgments from customers, with only a small amount of explicit dissatisfaction visible in the sampled fragments.

negative.summary: Negative examples mention acknowledgment of a concern about removed hard buttons and acknowledgment after an explanation of the only issue the customer wanted to raise.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples are mostly terse statements that a customer acknowledged information or comments without enough context to identify any sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are formulaic acknowledgment statements with too little context to determine the underlying customer opinion.
The topic appears to capture service-writer documentation language rather than a single coherent vehicle issue.
Only two negative examples are available, so concrete negative themes are limited to those fragments.
